The '''2014–15 Tennessee Tech Golden Eagles men's basketball team''' represented [[Tennessee Technological University]] during the [[2014–15 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Golden Eagles, led by fourth-year head coach [[Steve Payne (basketball)|Steve Payne]], played their home games at the [[Eblen Center]] and were members of the East Division of the [[Ohio Valley Conference]]. They finished the season 12–18, 4–12 in OVC play to finish in fifth place in the East Division. They failed to qualify for the OVC Tournament.
